senses.definition: In a strange or coincidental manner.
examples: Though I'd never gone to Boston before, everything looked strangely familiar.
Daniel was walking strangely because he had twisted his ankle.

quotes.text: A tale of gangland warfare and filial loyalty in the Glasgow of 1958, Small Faces is an enjoyable but strangely unmoving film.
[…]all thy vexations / Were but my trials of thy love, and thou / Hast strangely stood the test[…]
